$comment: WHERE THIS BOX IS, READ OFF ITS ENVIRONMENT. A cloud box has no person beside it, clones the tree cold, and cannot be told anything by hand, so the cage behaves differently there: it says which commit it is on, builds what a clone does not carry, and tells the agent how to get a diagnosis out. Every harness names its cloud with its own variable, so this is the one table of them, and one door reads it: util/cage/host.mjs for the cage and src/engine/host.go for the engine, both off this file. A harness not in the table is told about by hand with SE_CLOUD.

clouds.says: GitHub Actions, where the Copilot coding agent runs
set by hand, for a box the table does not know
